title: Audit safe-region refusals and overrides
description: Persist exact safety assumptions, violations, and one-preparation override evidence in immutable print preparations and verify contracts, browser refusal/override behavior, and deterministic PDF artifact inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Every successful preparation records exact boundary/radius confidence, requested unvalidated tolerance, content insets, SafeRegionResult identity, and ordered violations
An overridden preparation additionally records exact override violation identities, disclosure version, and explicit confirmation without a physical-safety status
A non-overridden violating attempt creates no preparation or artifact
Reproducing preparation inputs yields the same safety results, violation order, PaginationPlan, printable scene, and deterministic PDF inputs
Contract tests cover square, known rounded, estimated, unknown, extreme inset, nested, overlay, refusal, stale override, and one-use override cases
Browser tests verify keyboard correction/refusal/override and preparation inspection
Visible and persisted language never claims validated tolerance, physical containment, placement, scale, printing, or calibration

steps.details: Add normalized SafetyRequest, radius confidence, SafeRegionResult identity, ordered SceneViolations, and optional consumed PreparationOverride to TASK-32 preparation inputs.
Assert default refusal writes nothing; assert confirmed generation writes one immutable matching preparation and cannot reuse or silently broaden the override.
Replay canonical preparation inputs and compare safety results, violation ordering, page/position plan, scene identity, PDF bytes/hash, and audit fields.

steps.description: Run focused contract and browser checks
steps.details: Execute the rounded-region fixture matrix and Playwright keyboard flow, inspect saved preparation disclosures, then run build and lint checks relevant to the slice.

technicalNotes: Keep the task within ten minutes by extending existing preparation fixtures and running focused test filters rather than the full suite.
These records audit software assumptions and informed override only. Physical evidence remains absent and no physical conclusion is permitted.
